intro.text: Your little fingers complete the home row: A on the left and the semicolon (;) on the right. With A, you can type real words!
intro.tip: Little fingers are small but mighty – keep your wrists level so they can reach comfortably.

steps.title: Meet A and ;
steps.instructions: Press each key as it lights up. Take your time – the cursor waits for the right key.

steps.title: Guided drill
steps.text: aaa ;;; a;a ;a; sas l;l asdf jkl; a;sl ;ald
steps.instructions: Keep your fingers on the home row and move only the finger you need.

steps.title: Mix it up
steps.instructions: The new keys are mixed with the ones you already know.

steps.title: Real words
steps.instructions: Every word uses only the keys you’ve learnt so far.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: a lad; a dad; a sad lass; all lads ask; dad adds a salad; a flask falls;
steps.instructions: The keyboard hints fade out now – trust your fingers!
